formats.name: text_post
formats.notes: Needs message or link. Visible length before See more about 125 chars mobile (third-party).

formats.name: photo_post
formats.notes: Ratio and size not confirmed from a Meta source. API posts via /page-id/photos with public url.

formats.name: link_post
formats.notes: Custom preview only if Page owns and verified the domain. Thumbnail jpg, jpeg, gif or png.

formats.name: feed_video
formats.notes: API upload accepts video/mp4 only. Max length and size not confirmed.

formats.name: reel
formats.notes: Min 540x960. mp4, H.264 or H.265, 24-60 fps, AAC 48 kHz. Public only. 30 published per Page per 24 h via API.

formats.name: story_photo
formats.notes: JPEG, BMP, PNG, GIF, TIFF. Keep PNG under about 1 MB. Media already in a published post cannot be reused.

formats.name: story_video
formats.notes: Page story video cannot exceed 60 s. Min 540x960. 24-60 fps.

formats.name: live_video
formats.notes: Needs publish_video permission for API. Limits not confirmed.
